definition_en: a small number of people or things, not many

examples.supportive: Only a few people are here, so the room is almost empty.
examples.neutral: A few students are ready now.

items: Only ____ people are at the meeting, so it is quiet.
She has ____ friends here because she is new in this town.
There are ____ cars on the street at this time.
he_interference_note: בעברית 'מעט' משמש גם לספירים וגם ללא ספירים, ולכן דוברי עברית כותבים few water במקום little water.

definition_en: the part of the body at the end of the arm, with fingers

examples.supportive: She was writing the letter with her right hand and a pen.
examples.neutral: His hand was very cold this morning.

items: He was holding the small child by the ____.
Please put up your ____ if you have a question.
The doctor looked at the cut on my ____ and my arm.
he_interference_note: בעברית 'יד' מכסה גם את כף היד וגם את הזרוע, ולכן דוברי עברית כותבים hand במקום arm.

definition_en: the condition that somebody or something is in at a certain time

examples.supportive: The old house was in a very bad state after the fire.
examples.neutral: The report describes the state of the company.

items: After the accident the car was in a terrible ____.
The doctor asked about the ____ of my health.
Nobody knows the real ____ of the building today.
he_interference_note: בעברית 'מצב' מכסה state · situation · condition, ולכן דוברי עברית בוחרים situation גם כשהאנגלית דורשת state.

definition_en: one of the areas with its own government that together form a country

examples.supportive: This country is divided into states, and each state has its own laws.
examples.neutral: The state built a new road.

items: Each ____ in this country makes its own laws about schools.
He moved to another ____ to look for a better job.
The ____ pays for the roads and the public schools.
he_interference_note: state באנגלית אמריקאית הוא יחידה בתוך מדינה ולא country; דוברי עברית מתרגמים 'מדינה' ל-state וכותבים the state of Israel is in Asia כשכוונתם country.

definition_en: to change place or position, or to make something change place

examples.supportive: Please move your chair a little so I can pass.
examples.neutral: The workers move the boxes every morning.

items: Do not ____ while the doctor looks at your eyes.
Can you ____ the table near the window, please?
The old man could not ____ his arm after the fall.
he_interference_note: בעברית 'לזוז' עומד ו'להזיז' יוצא; move הוא אותה מילה לשניהם, ולכן דוברי עברית מוסיפים מושא מיותר או משמיטים אותו.

definition_en: to go to live in a different house or city

examples.supportive: They will move to a new house in the city next month.
examples.neutral: My sister is moving again this year.

items: We are going to ____ to a bigger house next year.
After she got the job she had to ____ to another city.
They want to ____ because the rent here is too high.
he_interference_note: 'לעבור' בעברית הוא גם move וגם pass; דוברי עברית כותבים we passed to a new house במקום we moved.

definition_en: what people use to buy things, such as coins and notes

examples.supportive: He has no money, so he cannot buy the book.
examples.neutral: The money is on the table.

items: I need more ____ to pay for this trip.
She saves her ____ every month in the bank.
They lost all their ____ when the shop closed.
he_interference_note: 'כסף' בעברית הוא גם money וגם המתכת silver, ודוברי עברית כותבים silver כשכוונתם לכסף לתשלום.

definition_en: used to add something surprising after what was said before

examples.supportive: The plan was good; however, it cost too much for us.
examples.neutral: However, the answer was not clear.

items: The food was cheap; ____, it did not taste very good.
She studied hard; ____, she did not pass the test.
It was raining. ____, we decided to walk to the shop.
he_interference_note: דוברי עברית משתמשים ב-however כמו 'אבל' באמצע משפט (I wanted to go however I stayed) במקום לפתוח בו משפט חדש או להפריד בנקודה-פסיק.

definition_en: to give something to somebody that they need

examples.supportive: The school provides free books for every student in the class.
examples.neutral: The company provides the same service.

items: The hotel will ____ a free breakfast for every guest.
Farmers ____ the food that we eat every day.
The city must ____ clean water to all its people.
he_interference_note: בעברית 'לספק משהו למישהו'; דוברי עברית כותבים provide somebody something ומשמיטים את with או את to.

definition_en: the word that a person or thing is called

examples.supportive: My name is written on the front of the book.
examples.neutral: The name was hard to remember.

items: Please write your full ____ at the top of this page.
I forgot the ____ of the street where she lives.
What is the ____ of that tall building near the river?
he_interference_note: 'שם' בעברית הוא גם name וגם תואר הפועל there, ודוברי עברית מבלבלים ביניהם בתרגום מהיר.

definition_en: to look at words and understand what they mean

examples.supportive: She reads the newspaper every morning before she goes to work.
examples.neutral: He reads in the evening.

items: I want to ____ this book before the class next week.
Children learn to ____ short stories in their first year at school.
Can you ____ the sign on the door from here?
he_interference_note: 'לקרוא' בעברית הוא גם read וגם call; דוברי עברית כותבים I read him on the phone במקום I called him.

definition_en: one of the parts that a year is divided into

examples.supportive: This month has more rain than the month before it.
examples.neutral: The next month will be busy.

items: She pays the rent at the start of every ____.

he_interference_note: בעברית 'חודשיים' היא מילה אחת; דוברי עברית מחפשים לה מקבילה וכותבים two month במקום two months.

definition_en: not having or not using something

examples.supportive: He went out without a coat, so he was very cold.
examples.neutral: She finished the work without help.

items: You cannot enter the building ____ a ticket.
He drinks his coffee ____ sugar every morning.

he_interference_note: אחרי without בא שם פועל בצורת ing‏; דוברי עברית גוזרים מ'בלי לומר' וכותבים without to say.

definition_en: facts or details about somebody or something

examples.supportive: The book gives useful information about the trip and the hotel.
examples.neutral: The information was sent this morning.

The book has a lot of ____ about local history.
Please give me the ____ about the train times.
he_interference_note: information אינו ספיר באנגלית; דוברי עברית גוזרים מ'מידעים' וכותבים informations או an information.

definition_en: the way that things are arranged, one after another

examples.supportive: The names are in order, so it is easy to find one.
examples.neutral: The order of the words is important.

The names on the list are not in any ____.
Please keep your papers in ____ so we can find them.
he_interference_note: בעברית 'בסדר' פירושו גם fine וגם in order; דוברי עברית עונים in order כשכוונתם okay.

definition_en: a request for food or goods that you want to buy

examples.supportive: The waiter took our order and brought the food quickly.
examples.neutral: The order arrived very late.

items: The shop sent my ____ to the wrong street.

The company received a large ____ from a new customer.
he_interference_note: 'הזמנה' מכסה order (בחנות) · invitation (לאירוע) · reservation (במסעדה), ודוברי עברית משתמשים ב-order לשלושתם.

definition_en: to ask for food or goods to be brought to you

examples.supportive: She ordered a coffee and a cake at the restaurant.
examples.neutral: They order it every week.

items: I want to ____ a new phone from that shop today.
You can ____ your food at the desk near the door.
They will ____ more chairs for the office next week.
he_interference_note: 'להזמין' מכסה order · invite · reserve; דוברי עברית כותבים I invited a pizza במקום I ordered a pizza.

definition_en: the group of people who control a country

examples.supportive: The government decided to build new schools in every city.
examples.neutral: The government answered the letter.

items: The ____ must find money for the new hospital.
Many people voted against the ____ at the last election.
The ____ said that the price of bread will not rise.

definition_en: a single unit of language that has a meaning

examples.supportive: I did not know that word, so I asked my teacher.
examples.neutral: The word was written on the board.

items: Can you spell that ____ for me, please?
She wrote a long letter but did not say a single ____.
The teacher asked us to write the ____ on the board.
he_interference_note: בעברית אין תווית סתמית; דוברי עברית כותבים did not say word במקום did not say a word.

definition_en: an important subject that people discuss or argue about

examples.supportive: Health is an important issue that the government must discuss.
examples.neutral: The issue was not easy.

This is a serious ____ for every family in the country.
The newspaper wrote about the same ____ last week.
he_interference_note: 'נושא' בעברית הוא subject · topic · issue; דוברי עברית בוחרים subject גם כשמדובר בנושא שנוי במחלוקת, שבו האנגלית דורשת issue.

definition_en: one of a series of magazines or newspapers printed at a certain time

examples.supportive: The new issue of the magazine comes out every month.
examples.neutral: I read that issue last week.

items: The first ____ of the newspaper was printed many years ago.
She keeps every ____ of that magazine on her shelf.
The next ____ will have a long story about the city.

definition_en: a place where people meet to buy and sell food and goods

examples.supportive: She buys fresh fruit at the market every morning.
examples.neutral: The market opens early.

He sells fish at the ____ every morning.
he_interference_note: 'שוק' בעברית הוא גם market וגם החלק בגוף; דוברי עברית אומרים in the market במשמעות הכלכלית, אך on the market באנגלית פירושו 'מוצע למכירה'.

examples.neutral: She pays at the end of the week.

They ____ their rent at the start of every month.
Can I ____ with a card in this shop?
he_interference_note: בעברית 'לשלם על משהו'; דוברי עברית כותבים pay on the ticket במקום pay for the ticket.

definition_en: to make something by putting parts together

examples.supportive: They are building a new bridge over the river this year.
examples.neutral: The company builds them every year.

items: The city wants to ____ a new school near the park.
Birds ____ their homes in these tall trees.
It takes many months to ____ a large hospital.
he_interference_note: צורת העבר של build אינה builded אלא built; דוברי עברית, שאין להם פעלים לא רגולריים, מכלילים את הכלל הרגולרי.

definition_en: the help that a shop, hotel or company gives to its customers

he_interference_note: בעברית 'שירות' הוא גם service וגם השירות הצבאי; דוברי עברית כותבים I did my service בלי military ומשאירים את הקורא בלי הקשר.

he_interference_note: בעברית 'נגד' משמש גם ל-versus במשחקים; דוברי עברית כותבים we played versus them במקום we played against them.

definition_en: coming after the first one

examples.neutral: The second answer was better.

items: He lives on the ____ floor of that tall building.

definition_en: to like somebody or something very much

definition_en: a very strong feeling of liking somebody

examples.neutral: The love in that letter was clear.

Her ____ for music started when she was very young.

definition_en: something that happens because of something else

They drove ____ and did not look back.
he_interference_note: בעברית 'רחוק' משמש גם כתואר וגם כתואר הפועל; דוברי עברית כותבים the school is away far או משמיטים את away ב-far away.

definition_en: a thing that shows what a larger group is like

This story is a good ____ of her early writing.
This is a clear ____ of what we should not do.

definition_en: to say that you are ready to give something or do something

examples.neutral: The bank offers it to everyone.

The hotel does not ____ breakfast in the rooms.
he_interference_note: 'להציע' מכסה offer · suggest · propose; דוברי עברית כותבים he offered that we go במקום he suggested that we go.

examples.neutral: The program was very long.

he_interference_note: 'תוכנית' בעברית היא גם program וגם plan; דוברי עברית שואלים what is your program for tomorrow במקום what is your plan.

definition_en: to go in front of people to show them the way

examples.neutral: She leads them every morning.

This path will ____ you to the top of the hill.
Who is going to ____ the group next week?
he_interference_note: צורת העבר של lead אינה leaded אלא led; דוברי עברית מכלילים את הכלל הרגולרי, ובנוסף מבלבלים בין lead ל-led בהגייה.

definition_en: to be in control of a group, a company or a country

A good manager must ____ and listen at the same time.
He will ____ the country for the next few years.

definition_en: to get something by giving money for it

examples.neutral: She buys it every week.

items: Where can I ____ a ticket for the train?
They want to ____ a house near the sea.
He does not have enough money to ____ that car.
he_interference_note: צורת העבר של buy אינה buyed אלא bought; דוברי עברית, שאין להם פעלים לא רגולריים, מכלילים את הכלל הרגולרי.

definition_en: to tell somebody that you are pleased about something they gave or did

examples.neutral: She thanked them at the end.

He wrote a letter to ____ them for the money.
The children should ____ their aunt for the gift.

definition_en: at or to a great distance

examples.neutral: It is far from the road.

definition_en: on this day

examples.neutral: The shop is closed today.

he_interference_note: hour מתחיל בתנועה בהגייה ולכן לוקח an ולא a; דוברי עברית, שרואים h בכתיב, כותבים a hour.

definition_en: a person who is studying at a university or college

definition_en: the front part of the head, with the eyes, nose and mouth

definition_en: to have to deal with a difficult situation

examples.neutral: They face it every year.

examples.neutral: She has less than before.

he_interference_note: 'פחות' בעברית אחיד; באנגלית less לבלתי ספירים ו-fewer לספירים, ודוברי עברית כותבים less books במקום fewer books.

definition_en: a part of a building with its own walls, floor and door

examples.neutral: The room was very quiet.

The hotel gave us a ____ near the garden.

definition_en: space that is free for somebody or something
